correctness.rationale: Exact all-ranks quotient-pair proof: 0 present by collision; nonzero missing g leads to empty/full/single fiber equations. Transversal implies affine graph by vanishing second differences; a full fiber forces f=m/2 and r=4 with affinely independent quotient four-set. Hyperplane coverage and all counts proved, not extrapolated. Finite verifier tests all 12,870 rank-four sets and 62 rank-five hyperplanes.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The prior size theorem plus example gives existence but not the iff: it is compatible with extra non-hyperplane half-sized obstructions in every rank. Indeed rank four has such extra obstructions, so a separate proof is required to establish rigidity from rank five onward. The finite spectral theorem cannot supply this all-rank implication.

value.rationale: The equality case at the historically sharp restricted four-sum critical threshold is a natural inverse structural question. It has a genuine low-rank exception and a new sharp rank-five rigidity boundary; the proof identifies all extremizers in infinitely many binary vector spaces, a stronger, motivated statement than numerical threshold attainment.
